datasets.title: Uganda Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2020
datasets.description: Uganda Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/uganda_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2020, classifying geographic areas in Uganda by food insecurity phase. The spatial data was compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files representing the current food insecurity situation across the country.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity status across geographic areas.
